name: SpimHub
description: Official SpimHub extensions. Fork this folder to make your own extension server.

extensions.name: SpimHub pet
extensions.description: A small friend that lives in the corner: it celebrates your programs, cries with the exceptions and gives MIPS / RISC-V tips.
extensions.author: SpimHub

extensions.name: Confetti
extensions.description: Confetti when a program exits with code 0.
extensions.author: SpimHub

extensions.name: Number converter
extensions.description: Decimal, hexadecimal, binary, two's complement, IEEE-754 and ASCII. Panel + terminal command conv.
extensions.author: SpimHub

extensions.name: Instruction mix
extensions.description: After a run: how many ALU, load, store, branch and jump instructions were executed, the most used ones and the CPI.
extensions.author: SpimHub

extensions.name: Snippets
extensions.description: Insert common code (functions, loops, syscalls) in MIPS or RISC-V from the command palette.
extensions.author: SpimHub

extensions.name: Retro sounds
extensions.description: 8-bit sounds: a jingle when the program ends well, a buzz when it fails.
extensions.author: SpimHub

extensions.name: Dracula theme
extensions.description: The dark theme with the Dracula palette. An extension made only with CSS.
extensions.author: SpimHub
